turns.question: Is the hot hand real? Do guys hit more after three straight makes than after three straight misses?

sources.challenger: DETERMINISTIC_STANDIN (LLM not called: every applicable registered attack is already required)

turns.heater_text: LISTEN FOLKS the Ref says we just DON'T KNOW yet! I FEEL the hot hand in my soul, but that is just my opinion, BABY! Let's keep watching and find out!
turns.ref_text: Insufficient evidence (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE). Hot hand: three makes in a row (HH-K3). What was tested: Within a player-game, a field goal after 3 straight makes is made more often than one after 3 straight misses, beyond what within-stratum shuffling produces. Why: after-3-makes n=14, after-3-misses n=18, need >= 30 each.

turns.question: After a player makes two in a row, is the next shot more likely to go in than after two misses in a row?

sources.challenger: DETERMINISTIC_STANDIN (LLM not called: every applicable registered attack is already required)

turns.heater_text: OH BABY I love this one! The Ref says NOT SUPPORTED, so we live with the call! What a showdown, folks!
turns.ref_text: Not supported by the registered checks (NOT_SUPPORTED). Hot hand: two makes in a row (HH-K2). What was tested: Same as HH-K3 with streak length 2. Why: p=0.2390 (alpha 0.05), bias-corrected effect +0.0740 (floor 0.01).

turns.question: Does an Elo rating predict who wins better than just going with how often home teams win?
turns.heater_text: OH BABY, THE ELO CAME TO PLAY! The Ref says it survived, and I LOVE that fight! Give me ratings over gut feelings EVERY SINGLE NIGHT!
turns.ref_text: Survived the registered checks (SURVIVED_PROTOCOL). Elo vs the home-win base rate (GP-ELO). What was tested: A frozen Elo forecast has lower mean log loss than the home-win base-rate forecast on unseen 2023-24 final-split games. Why: Holm p<0.05, CI>0, mean>=floor. Source: Research's recorded final run on 300 unseen 2023-24 games, under a custodian exposure receipt; copied here, not recomputed.

turns.question: Do back-to-backs and rest days change who wins?
turns.heater_text: Listen, tired legs FEEL like a total GAME-CHANGER! The Ref says the evidence ISN'T THERE YET, so we roll with it! That's just my opinion, people!
turns.ref_text: Insufficient evidence (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE). Rest and back-to-backs on top of Elo (GP-REST). What was tested: Rest-day difference and back-to-backs improve pre-tip win forecasts over Elo. Why: CI includes values on both sides of the decision thresholds. Source: Research's recorded final run on 300 unseen 2023-24 games, under a custodian exposure receipt; copied here, not recomputed.
